title: Full Stack Developer | Angular & Spring Boot

intro: I am a Full Stack Developer with experience across the complete application lifecycle: designing Angular interfaces, building Java Spring Boot services and secure REST APIs, optimizing relational data access, managing changes with Git and GitHub, and supporting cloud deployments. I turn complex enterprise requirements into modular systems that are maintainable, testable, scalable, and ready for continuous delivery.

philosophy: I treat quality as a full-stack responsibility: clear API contracts, resilient backend services, well-modeled data, secure authentication and role-based access control, disciplined Git/GitHub workflows, automated CI/CD, containerization, and focused unit testing. I enjoy removing repetitive work through automation and building reliable systems that teams can extend with confidence.
closing: Building a product from interface to infrastructure? Let's connect!
